summary: INLIF Ltd, a Chinese industrial machinery issuer listed in the US, filed a routine Form 6-K containing unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 plus related XBRL exhibits, including disclosures of a March 2026 sales agreement and a July 2026 related-party transaction with Kerui Enterprise Limited. No special-situation event is present: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or management change is announced. The filing is informational only, so no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock arises; watch for future 6-K disclosures that could signal substantive corporate action.
